deploy.startCommand: sh -c "test -n \"$VOICETUT_UPSTREAM\" && test -n \"$VOICETUT_API_KEY\" && envsubst '$VOICETUT_UPSTREAM $VOICETUT_API_KEY' < /etc/nginx/nginx.conf.template > /tmp/openvenice-nginx.conf && chmod 600 /tmp/openvenice-nginx.conf && exec nginx -c /tmp/openvenice-nginx.conf -g 'daemon off;'"
